meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划自动跑完,并行分工并留存每一步执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有写好的工作计划,想让多个子任务并行落地并留下记录。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan end to end with parallel subtasks and recorded evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written work plan and want its subtasks run in parallel.

howto.what: 它读取 .omo/plans 里的工作计划，自己只做调度：把每项实现、测试、检查都派给并行子代理，用 .omo/ 记录进度和证据，直到所有顶层复选框做完。
howto.when: 当你说 ulw-execute，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发；如果还没有可选计划，会先调用 ulw-plan 生成一份再执行。

say.note: 每个阶段各开一个 PR 交付
PR 打开后跟进到合并

howto.what_en: It runs a plan from .omo/plans yet never implements itself: every implementation, test and review unit is delegated to parallel subagents, while progress and evidence stay in .omo/ until all top-level checkboxes are done.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say ulw-execute or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; if no selectable plan exists it bootstraps ulw-plan first.

say_en.note: Delivers each phase as a PR
Follows the PR until it merges
